days.title: Centre your first ball of clay
days.description: Wedge your clay to remove air bubbles. Try centring a small ball on the wheel.
days.tip: Keep your elbows anchored to your body for more control

days.title: Pinch pot fundamentals
days.description: Make 3 pinch pots. Focus on even wall thickness throughout.
days.tip: Rotate the clay as you pinch — never stay in one spot

days.title: Shape your first bowl
days.description: Using the wheel, open the clay and pull up the walls to form a bowl shape.
days.tip: Wet hands reduce friction but too much water weakens the clay

days.title: Trimming and finishing
days.description: Trim the base of yesterday's bowl. Add a foot ring if clay is leather-hard.
days.tip: Trim when clay is leather-hard — not too wet, not too dry

days.title: Hand building a mug
days.description: Roll a slab, form a cylinder, attach a pulled handle. Your first mug!
days.tip: Score and slip all joints — this prevents cracking during drying

days.title: Surface decoration
days.description: Try 3 surface techniques: stamping, carving, and slip trailing on test tiles.
days.tip: Decorate at leather-hard stage for best results

days.title: Week 1 review
days.description: Photograph all your pieces from this week. Note what you want to improve.
days.tip: Even professional potters throw away most of their first pieces — normal
